# Link Asia Manpower Solutions Corp.

> DMW-licensed Philippine land-based recruitment agency (License No. DMW-067-LB-03312023-R), established June 6, 2006, based in Alabang, Muntinlupa City, Metro Manila. We source, screen, document and deploy Filipino workers for foreign employers across the Middle East, Asia, Europe, Canada and the Caribbean.

Employers contact us at business@linkasiamanpower.ph or +63 939 906 9520 (call or WhatsApp). Job seekers contact hr.recruitment@linkasiamanpower.ph or apply through the online application form.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.linkasiamanpower.ph/): Who we are, markets we serve, worker categories and our recruitment process
- [For Employers](https://www.linkasiamanpower.ph/employers.html): How foreign employers hire Filipino workers through Link Asia, with a job-order inquiry form
- [For Applicants](https://www.linkasiamanpower.ph/applicants.html): How Filipino job seekers apply for overseas work through a licensed agency, with FAQs
- [Online Application Form](https://www.linkasiamanpower.ph/apply.html): Application form for skilled applicants
- [Articles](https://www.linkasiamanpower.ph/articles.html): Guides on hiring Filipino workers and working abroad
- [Contact](https://www.linkasiamanpower.ph/contact.html): Office address, email, phone and WhatsApp
